description: Plan a GB rail journey between two stations from the timetable, including changes: the next few ways to get there after a time, each with departure, arrival, number of changes and every train to catch with where to board and alight. This is the timetable, not live running; for live times on a direct train use station_departures with 'to', and for one train's progress use get_train with its planning ID.

date.description: Date, yyyy-MM-dd. Defaults to today (UK time).

from.description: Station to travel from: name or CRS code.

time.description: Leave after this time, HH:mm UK time. Defaults to now.

to.description: Station to travel to: name or CRS code.

name: plan_journey
title: Plan a rail journey
